info.cls_ename: Ph.D. Program, Department of Information Engineering and Computer Science

description.describe_ch: 學習深入作業系統內部設計原理，設計的議題與前瞻的分析外，進一步透過包含LINUX與UNIX作業系統原始碼的檢視與練習，訓練學生有增添驅動程式與進行系統呼叫等函式的能力。
description.describe_eh: To learn the in-depth discussion of the design principles of operating systems, including design considerations and advanced design-techniques. Furthermore, we will trace the source codes of UNIX/LINUX to train students so that they are able to add new device drivers and system calls.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解與分析UNIX作業系統內部的設計架構與原理
targets.describe_en: To teach graduate students identify the internal design concepts of an OS using UNIX as an example.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解如何應用系統增加LINUX系統呼叫與擴充核心功能的方法
targets.describe_en: To teach graduate students understand how to extend desired functions to an OS and add system call services in an OS. Linux

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解近代作業系統多線程機制設計之工作處理效能程式
targets.describe_en: To teach graduate students understand how to design high performance AP by utilizing the multithreading mechanism supported in OS.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解近代作業系統記憶體對映檔案機制來為應用程式設計高效能大量檔案存取
targets.describe_en: To teach graduate students understand how to design a high performance file-intensive AP using memory-mapped file support of an OS.
